title: Use saved files as the KiCad 10 synchronization boundary
rationale: Supported KiCad 10 interfaces cannot prove unsaved Schematic, Symbol, or Footprint Editor state. Scan after saves, label results as last-saved state, never modify an open design behind KiCad, and use guided native replacement or a guarded closed-project transform. Defer library activation until KiCad closes when editor cleanliness is unknown.

title: Render symbol and footprint previews with the installed kicad-cli
rationale: Previews are SVGs from `kicad-cli sym export svg [-s SYMBOL]` and `kicad-cli fp export svg [--fp NAME]`, which use KiCad's own drawing code, so they match what KiCad shows without an app-side renderer. KiCad's chooser preview panes can't be embedded in another app. Find kicad-cli in standard install locations (Windows: Program Files\KiCad\<version>\bin) plus a user override. Cache SVGs by library content hash and KiCad version, and export whole libraries in batches. Measured on KiCad 10.0.4 on 2026-10-08: about 0.25 s per part, and about 11 s for all 35 repository libraries (241 SVGs). `kicad-cli pcb render` can provide 3D images later through a temporary board.

description: kicad-cli 10.0.4 'fp export svg' exits 0 even when it writes nothing (missing footprint, missing output dir), needs its output directory to exist (unlike 'sym export svg'), and loads every footprint in the .pretty before exporting one. Measured on 2026-10-08: with a warm disk cache the whole .pretty costs about 0.44-0.62 s for KiCad's Package_SO and 0.91 s for Package_DFN_QFN, against about 0.28 s for a one-footprint library; a cold disk cache took about 2.2 s for Package_SO.
resolution: Treat an export as successful only if an SVG named for the requested item was written, and report stdout+stderr otherwise; create the output directory first; copy the one .kicad_mod into a temporary one-footprint .pretty and export from there. Pass --theme _builtin_default so output ignores the user's editor colours. Reject names starting with '-' (kicad-cli parses them as options). See crates/kicad-integration/src/preview.rs.

title: Export kicad-cli previews lazily, one item per cache miss
rationale: Previews are SVGs from 'kicad-cli sym export svg --symbol NAME' and 'kicad-cli fp export svg --footprint NAME' (KiCad's own drawing code, no app-side renderer), found via standard install locations or a user override. The app exports only the selected symbol (every unit, De Morgan bodies labelled) or footprint on a cache miss, so the first view of an item waits about 0.3-0.6 s; repeat views read the cache and never run kicad-cli. Libraries are not exported in batches: whole-library export (about 11 s for all 35 repository libraries) would delay first use and waste work on KiCad's large bundled libraries. The cache is keyed by library content SHA-256, KiCad version and colour theme, and lives in the app cache directory. kicad-cli pcb render can provide 3D images later through a temporary board.
